lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Blood Court-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Pup Vampire Thrall Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Vampire Thrall Awakened. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Vampire Thrall Awakeneds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Vampire Thrall Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Knotted Vampire Thrall Awakened
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Vampire Thrall Awakened bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded Vampire Thrall Awakened
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Vampire Thrall Awakened — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Vampire Thrall Awakened is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Vampire Thrall Awakened of the Apex
star_6.appearance: Vampire Thrall Awakened now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Vampire Thrall Awakeneds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Absolute Vampire Thrall Awakened
star_7.appearance: The final form. Vampire Thrall Awakened stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.name: Spawn Grim Wisp
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Grim Wisp. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Grim Wisps in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Grim Wisp
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Hatchling Storm Werewolf Scout Prime
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Storm Werewolf Scout Prime. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Storm Werewolf Scout Primes in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Storm Werewolf Scout Prime
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Bud Specter Blessed

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Specter Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Specter Blessed

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Young Chosen Elder Vampire

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Chosen Elder Vampire

base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Seed Mythic Mahito Shapeless

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Mythic Mahito Shapelesss in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Mythic Mahito Shapeless

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Young Dread Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Dread Wraith Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Dread Wraith Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Dread Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Wisp Corrupted

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Wisp Corrupteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Spectral-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Decayed Wraith III
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Decayed Wraith III. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Decayed Wraith IIIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Decayed Wraith III
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Lesser Vampire Spawn II

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Vampire Spawn IIs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Vampire Spawn II

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Young Sewer Cursed Villager
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sewer Cursed Villager. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Sewer Cursed Villagers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Sewer Cursed Villager
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Werewolf Juvenile Senior — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Werewolf Juvenile Senior is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Werewolf Juvenile Senior the Last
star_6.appearance: Werewolf Juvenile Senior now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Werewolf Juvenile Seniors have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Final Werewolf Juvenile Senior
star_7.appearance: The final form. Werewolf Juvenile Senior stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Werewolf Juvenile Senior is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Waking Dream" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Insectoid-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Bud Cursed Peasant Senior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Cursed Peasant Senior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Cursed Peasant Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Awakened Cursed Peasant Senior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Fledgling Soul Vampire Elder

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Soul Vampire Elders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Stirring Soul Vampire Elder

base_chain.name: Seed Gaunt Wisp

base_chain.name: Spawn Eternal Nnoitra Scythe

base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Banshee Cry Elite — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Banshee Cry Elite is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_6.name: Banshee Cry Elite the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Banshee Cry Elite now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Banshee Cry Elites have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

base_chain.name: Lesser Weak Spirit
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Weak Spirit. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Weak Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Spawn Vile Grave Ghoul

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Vile Grave Ghouls in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.name: Kindling Vile Grave Ghoul

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Lupine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Pup Crimson Werewolf Scout
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Crimson Werewolf Scout. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Crimson Werewolf Scouts in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Emerging Crimson Werewolf Scout
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Rune Iron Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Emerging Rune Iron Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Rune Iron Golem
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Rune Iron Golem bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Rune Iron Golem
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Rune Iron Golem — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Rune Iron Golem is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

star_6.name: Rune Iron Golem the Ancient
star_6.appearance: Rune Iron Golem now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Rune Iron Golems have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Last Form Rune Iron Golem

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Swamp Hag Major
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Swamp Hag Major. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Swamp Hag Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Swamp Hag Major
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Swamp Hag Major

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Young Scraggly Barrow Ghoul Young
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Scraggly Barrow Ghoul Young. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Scraggly Barrow Ghoul Youngs in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Scraggly Barrow Ghoul Young
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Elemental-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Faint Spirit Lesser
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Faint Spirit Lesser. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Faint Spirit Lessers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Faint Spirit Lesser
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Newborn Hungry Banshee Cry
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Hungry Banshee Cry. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Hungry Banshee Crys in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: First-Form Hungry Banshee Cry

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Seed Cursed Merchant Blessed

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Seed Ravaged Swamp Hag Senior
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Ravaged Swamp Hag Senior. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Ravaged Swamp Hag Seniors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Ravaged Swamp Hag Senior
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Ravaged Swamp Hag Senior
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Ravaged Swamp Hag Senior bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Ravaged Swamp Hag Senior
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Blighted Werewolf Pack Blessed
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Blighted Werewolf Pack Blessed bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Blighted Werewolf Pack Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Blighted Werewolf Pack Blessed — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Blighted Werewolf Pack Blessed is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Blighted Werewolf Pack Blessed the Undying
star_6.appearance: Blighted Werewolf Pack Blessed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Blighted Werewolf Pack Blesseds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded Eternal Night Knight
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Eternal Night Knight — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Eternal Night Knight is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

star_6.name: Eternal Night Knight Transcendent
star_6.appearance: Eternal Night Knight now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Eternal Night Knights have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Myth Eternal Night Knight
star_7.appearance: The final form. Eternal Night Knight stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Eternal Night Knight is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Waking Dream" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Wisp Scraggly Dark Wisp Lesser
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Scraggly Dark Wisp Lesser. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Scraggly Dark Wisp Lessers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Scraggly Dark Wisp Lesser

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.name: Spawn Dingy Weak Spirit

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Lupine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Young Eclipse Werewolf Alpha
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Eclipse Werewolf Alpha. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Eclipse Werewolf Alphas in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Eclipse Werewolf Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Eclipse Werewolf Alpha
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Eclipse Werewolf Alpha bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Eclipse Werewolf Alpha

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.name: Wisp Wrathful Legion Hive
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Wrathful Legion Hive. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Wrathful Legion Hives in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Wrathful Legion Hive
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Spawn Murky Crypt Ghoul Major
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Murky Crypt Ghoul Major. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Murky Crypt Ghoul Majors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Murky Crypt Ghoul Major
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Void Entity-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Lesser Pale Shadow Wisp
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Pale Shadow Wisp. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Pale Shadow Wisps in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: First-Form Pale Shadow Wisp
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Pale Shadow Wisp
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Pale Shadow Wisp bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Pale Shadow Wisp

tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Seed Faint Spirit
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Faint Spirit. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Faint Spirits in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Emerging Faint Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Scrawny Faint Spirit
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Faint Spirit bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Faint Spirit
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Faint Spirit — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Faint Spirit is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

star_6.name: Faint Spirit the First
star_6.appearance: Faint Spirit now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Faint Spirits have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Absolute Faint Spirit
star_7.appearance: The final form. Faint Spirit stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Faint Spirit is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Waking Dream" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Young Drowned Vampire Thrall
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Drowned Vampire Thrall. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Drowned Vampire Thralls in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Kindling Drowned Vampire Thrall
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Construct-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Seed Primordial Stone Golem
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Primordial Stone Golem. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Primordial Stone Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Primordial Stone Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Primordial Stone Golem
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Primordial Stone Golem bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Branded Primordial Stone Golem
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Seed Abyss Phantom Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Abyss Phantom Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Abyss Phantom Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Abyss Phantom Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.

base_chain.name: Lesser Giant Iron Golem
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Giant Iron Golem. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Giant Iron Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Stirring Giant Iron Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

base_chain.name: Kindling Lanky Shadow Bat

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Construct-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. base_chain.name: Newborn Arcane Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Arcane Golem Guardian. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Arcane Golem Guardians in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Rising Arcane Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Spectral-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Phantom Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Phantom Corrupted. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Phantom Corrupteds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Rising Phantom Corrupted
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Young Malevolent Night Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Malevolent Night Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Malevolent Night Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Awakened Malevolent Night Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Malevolent Night Knight
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Malevolent Night Knight bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Pup Lanky Haunted Armor Minor

base_chain.name: Lesser Infernal Legion Hive
