base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Infernal Legion Hives in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Infernal Legion Hive
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Wisp Vampire Servant Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Vampire Servant Blessed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Vampire Servant Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Stirring Vampire Servant Blessed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Lesser Pale Ghoul

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Young Filthy Grave Ghoul
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Filthy Grave Ghoul. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Filthy Grave Ghouls in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

base_chain.name: Emerging Filthy Grave Ghoul
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: Filthy Grave Ghoul
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Filthy Grave Ghoul bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Filthy Grave Ghoul

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Newborn Phantom Lesser
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Phantom Lesser. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Phantom Lessers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Phantom Lesser
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Phantom Lesser
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Phantom Lesser bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Phantom Lesser
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Phantom Lesser — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Phantom Lesser is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

star_6.name: Phantom Lesser Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Phantom Lesser now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Phantom Lessers have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Legend Phantom Lesser
star_7.appearance: The final form. Phantom Lesser stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Phantom Lesser is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Waking Dream" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Wisp Bleached Vampire Servant Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Bleached Vampire Servant Blessed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Bleached Vampire Servant Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.name: First-Form Bleached Vampire Servant Blessed

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Dragon Banshee Queen — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Dragon Banshee Queen is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

star_6.name: Dragon Banshee Queen Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Dragon Banshee Queen now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Dragon Banshee Queens have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Spawn Crowned Grand Golem
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Crowned Grand Golem. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Crowned Grand Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Crowned Grand Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Pup Tempest Vampire Elder
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Tempest Vampire Elder. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Tempest Vampire Elders in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Tempest Vampire Elder
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Hatchling Abyss Shadow Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Abyss Shadow Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Abyss Shadow Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Stirring Abyss Shadow Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Crimson Vampire Thrall

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Soggy Wisp Omega — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Soggy Wisp Omega is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Soggy Wisp Omega the Undying
star_6.appearance: Soggy Wisp Omega now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Soggy Wisp Omegas have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

base_chain.name: Wisp Mire Hag Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Mire Hag Blessed. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Mire Hag Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: First-Form Mire Hag Blessed

base_chain.name: Hatchling Voidborn Legion Hive
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Voidborn Legion Hive. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Voidborn Legion Hives in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: First-Form Voidborn Legion Hive
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Spawn Titan Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Titan Wraith Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Titan Wraith Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Kindling Titan Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Warborn-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Bud Royal Shadow Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Royal Shadow Champion. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Royal Shadow Champions in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Royal Shadow Champion
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Royal Shadow Champion

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

base_chain.name: Hatchling Haunted Weapon

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Haunted Weapons in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Bud Transcendent Death Reaper
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Transcendent Death Reaper. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Transcendent Death Reapers in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Emerging Transcendent Death Reaper
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Transcendent Death Reaper
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Transcendent Death Reaper bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Transcendent Death Reaper
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Seed Gaunt Wisp
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Gaunt Wisp. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Gaunt Wisps in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Awakened Gaunt Wisp
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.name: Grimy Gaunt Wisp
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Gaunt Wisp bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Gaunt Wisp
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Lupine-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Seed Werewolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Werewolf Minor. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Werewolf Minors in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Kindling Werewolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Werewolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Werewolf Minor bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Werewolf Minor
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Knight-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Wisp Shadowed Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shadowed Wraith Knight. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Shadowed Wraith Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Stirring Shadowed Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Shadowed Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Shadowed Wraith Knight bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Shadowed Wraith Knight
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Shadowed Wraith Knight — Nightmare Sovereign

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Shadowed Wraith Knight is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Shadowed Wraith Knight Incarnate

star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

base_chain.name: Seed Werewolf Pack

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.

base_chain.name: Kindling Werewolf Pack

base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Shadow Night Bat Blesseds in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

base_chain.name: Stirring Shadow Night Bat Blessed
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Shadow Night Bat Blessed
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Shadow Night Bat Blessed bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Shadow Night Bat Blessed
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Shadow Night Bat Blessed — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Shadow Night Bat Blessed is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Shadow Night Bat Blessed the Feared
star_6.appearance: Shadow Night Bat Blessed now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Shadow Night Bat Blesseds have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

base_chain.name: Ascendant Immortal Walter Bernhard

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Chosen Plague Specter Knight
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Plague Specter Knight — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Plague Specter Knight is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

star_6.name: Plague Specter Knight Incarnate
star_6.appearance: Plague Specter Knight now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Plague Specter Knights have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: God-King Plague Specter Knight
star_7.appearance: The final form. Plague Specter Knight stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Plague Specter Knight is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Waking Dream" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.name: Lesser Cursed Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Cursed Golem Guardian. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Cursed Golem Guardians in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Stirring Cursed Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.

tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Hatchling Pitted Werewolf Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Pitted Werewolf Juvenile. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Pitted Werewolf Juveniles in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Pitted Werewolf Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Pitted Werewolf Juvenile bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Marked Pitted Werewolf Juvenile
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Pitted Werewolf Juvenile — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Pitted Werewolf Juvenile is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

star_6.name: Pitted Werewolf Juvenile the Undying
star_6.appearance: Pitted Werewolf Juvenile now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Pitted Werewolf Juveniles have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Undying Nnoitra Scythe
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Undying Nnoitra Scythe bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Exalted Undying Nnoitra Scythe
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Resilient Aura — reduces all incoming damage by 5%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Undying Nnoitra Scythe — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Undying Nnoitra Scythe is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

star_6.name: Undying Nnoitra Scythe of the Abyss
star_6.appearance: Undying Nnoitra Scythe now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Undying Nnoitra Scythes have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Final Undying Nnoitra Scythe
star_7.appearance: The final form. Undying Nnoitra Scythe stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Undying Nnoitra Scythe is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Waking Dream" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Crowned Sinuous Werewolf Scout IV
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.

star_5.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

star_6.name: Sinuous Werewolf Scout IV the Eternal
star_6.appearance: Sinuous Werewolf Scout IV now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.

star_6.passive: Tamer Bond — gains +5% all stats per star level of the tamer's highest-star monster

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster

star_5.name: Spectral Shadow Knight — Nightmare Sovereign
star_5.appearance: The Nightmare path has reshaped this creature completely. Its form is now iconic — instantly recognizable as a Sovereign-class entity. Those who see it know: this is not a creature to be trifled with.
star_5.personality: Commands respect naturally. Has developed a code — a personal philosophy that the Nightmare Path has crystallized into something unshakeable.
star_5.lore: A Sovereign-class Spectral Shadow Knight is a living landmark. Traders route their caravans around their territories. Tamers who command one are given titles in the guild halls of Haunted Veil. The realm itself seems to respond to their presence.
star_5.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

star_6.name: Spectral Shadow Knight the Last
star_6.appearance: Spectral Shadow Knight now defies easy description. Its form flickers between states — sometimes solid, sometimes spectral. The element it wields has become an extension of its identity rather than a tool.
star_6.personality: Serene. Has moved beyond the need to prove itself. Speaks rarely but always with weight.
star_6.lore: Only a handful of Transcendent Spectral Shadow Knights have ever been recorded. Each one changed the region it inhabited — either saving it or devastating it, depending on the tamer's choices. Their names are written in the Codex in gold ink.
star_6.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Obtain 1 Transcendence Stone + Veil of Eternal Night

star_7.name: Final Spectral Shadow Knight
star_7.appearance: The final form. Spectral Shadow Knight stands as a pillar of its realm — a living legend whose existence reshapes the world around it. Tamers lucky enough to bond with one are marked for life.
star_7.personality: Eternal. Its personality is now part of the world's fabric. Stories are told about it in villages it has never visited.
star_7.lore: The Apex form of Spectral Shadow Knight is reached only through the completion of the legendary "The Waking Dream" story arc. Once achieved, the creature is no longer merely a monster — it is a myth given form. Its tamer becomes part of that myth.
star_7.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Construct-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Spawn Shadowed Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Shadowed Golem Guardian. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Shadowed Golem Guardians in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Iron Body — reduces debuff duration by 30%

base_chain.name: Awakened Shadowed Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

lore_summary: A creature of the Haunted Veil, aligned with Dread energy. Known among tamers as a Unnamed Terror-type entity. The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Fledgling Sable Legion Hive
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Sable Legion Hive. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Sable Legion Hives in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Feral Instinct — first strike each battle deals +15% damage

base_chain.name: Stirring Sable Legion Hive
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.

base_chain.name: Kindling Pitted Grave Hag Minor

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Void Step — 10% chance to evade any attack

base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Silver Dark Knights in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.

base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Jade Flesh Golems in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancestral Memory — starts each battle with a free skill charge

base_chain.name: Kindling Jade Flesh Golem
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Spawn Primordial Vampire Progenitor Ancient

base_chain.name: Spawn Infernal Specter Champion
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Infernal Specter Champion. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Infernal Specter Champions in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Ancient Knowledge — reveals enemy weaknesses at battle start

base_chain.name: Kindling Infernal Specter Champion

base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.

base_chain.passive: Death's Edge — gains +20% ATK when HP below 30%

It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
tamer_note: Dread tamers are called Confidants. Bond is formed through honest confession — the tamer must reveal a secret, and the monster judges its weight.

base_chain.name: Bud Primordial Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A small, compact form of Primordial Golem Guardian. Limbs are stubby and movements clumsy, but the eyes already glow with nascent elemental energy. Fur, scales, or hide appears fresh and unstained by battle.
base_chain.personality: Timid and curious. Bonds quickly with the first being who shows it food or warmth.
base_chain.lore: Found in the deepest, safest corners of Haunted Veil. Primordial Golem Guardians in this stage cluster together for warmth and are rarely seen by outsiders. Tamers who find them here are considered especially lucky — a Hatchling bond is the purest kind.
base_chain.passive: Bond Resonance — gains +1% to all stats per 10 Bond points

base_chain.name: Awakened Primordial Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The creature's element — Dread — begins to manifest visibly. Faint markings trace along the body, and breath comes with elemental wisps. Stands taller, moves with purpose.
base_chain.personality: Gaining confidence. Tests limits. Occasionally disobedient but not malicious.
base_chain.lore: The Awakened stage marks the creature's first true emergence into the ecology of Haunted Veil. It begins to claim small territory and establish feeding patterns. Other creatures learn to give it a wide berth.
base_chain.passive: Undying Will — survives one lethal hit per battle with 1 HP

base_chain.name: Primordial Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: The fully realized form. Primordial Golem Guardian bears the aesthetic of Haunted Veil — battle-worn, dignified, and unmistakably powerful. Element Dread crackles or flows freely from key points on the body.
base_chain.personality: Steady and reliable. Has developed a clear sense of self and values. Protective of its tamer.
base_chain.lore: The Champion form is the one most tamers seek. It is the creature as the world knows it — fully realized, capable, and deeply embedded in the lore of Haunted Veil. Codex scholars have written entire volumes about this stage alone.
base_chain.passive: Element Attunement — all elemental attacks gain +10% penetration

evolution_req.special: Clear  the night is honest. dungeon once

base_chain.name: Ascendant Primordial Golem Guardian
base_chain.appearance: A dramatic transformation. The body restructures to reflect the path chosen. Haunted Veil-specific motifs deepen — colors intensify, form sharpens, and a visible aura radiates outward.
base_chain.personality: The personality sharpens around the Nightmare Path. Focused, intentional, and quietly formidable.
base_chain.lore: Few creatures ever reach the Exalted threshold. In Haunted Veil, Exalted-class monsters are treated as minor lords of their territory. Other creatures of lower stars instinctively defer to them. Tamers with Exalted companions are rarely harassed on the road.
base_chain.passive: Pack Synergy — gains +8% ATK for each ally of the same realm

evolution_req.special: Win 30 battles as the lead monster
